# `state/transaction/Idempotency.js`

> **Source:** `engine/state/transaction/Idempotency.js`

state/transaction/Idempotency.js — replay protection (spec rule 21).  Every potentially duplicated operation carries an idempotency key (`actor:task:operation`). The default registry preserves canonical at-most- once receipts without eviction for CommitCoordinator and other durable callers. A bounded TTL/LRU policy is available only by explicit opt-in for process-local replay caches whose mutation safety lives in canonical state or a separate durable dispatch fence.

## Classes

### `class IdempotencyRegistry`

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `has` | `has(key)` | Has this idempotency key already been committed? |
| `get` | `get(key)` | Recorded result for a key, or null. |
| `record` | `record(key, transactionID, receipt)` | Record the first result for a key. No-op (returns existing) if already set. Default registries retain that replay indefinitely; explicitly bounded registries guarantee it only inside their configured replay window. |
| `sweep` | `sweep(now = null)` | Remove every expired settled receipt and return the number removed. |
| `metadata` | `metadata()` | Content-free cache diagnostics. Keys and receipts are never projected. |
